sentences.text: Case :- Application U/S 529 Bnss No. - 1818 of 2025

Applicant :- Informant
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Piyush Patel,Pradeep Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 529 Bnss has been filed with a prayer to direct the court
concerned to decide the Sessions Trial No. 1303 of 2023 in case crime no. 378 of 2023 under
Sections 366, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 Pocso Act, Police Station- Paniyara, District-Maharajganj pending
in the Court of learned Special Judge, Exclusive Court (Pocso Act), Maharajganj expeditiously
within stipulated period.

entities.text: Special Judge, Exclusive Court (Pocso Act), Maharajganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that in the case in hand only one witness has been examined and as P.W.2 partial evidence of the prosecutrix has been examined and now the trial is pending at the stage of cross-examination of P.W.2, the victim.
It is further submitted that earlier an Application U/S 528 BNSS No. 6804 of 2025 was moved by the informant, which was dismissed vide order dated 3.3.2025 by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court.

The matter relates to POCSO Act and in the POCSO Act itself stipulated time period has been mandated for the trial Court but however, the Court concerned is not taking proper interest in disposal of the said session trial.
Informant vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151633383/

entities.text: Informant vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.
6. In these circumstances, the trial Court is expected to pay attention to the mandatory provisions of the POCSO Act relating to the disposal of the aforesaid case in a time bound manner.
It is directed that the aforesaid case must be decided within the stipulated period provided under the POCSO Act from today.

7. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
8. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
